description: Complete NextBrain tree from nextbrain_ontology_v1.csv: L1-L4 columns are levels 1-4, leaf_name is level 5 with label = allen_id. Each level-1 tissue is an independent color. Left and right share a node. Jitters and L2/L3 r_max are illustrative; L4 and leaf r_max come from the table (best contrast = default, T1 = T1w).
